reader.requirement: At --std 85 control after a relative START follows §1985:VIII.1.3.5: an invalid key runs the INVALID KEY imperative (no USE procedure) or, if the phrase is absent, the USE procedure, NOT INVALID KEY ignored; success runs the NOT INVALID KEY imperative; another exception (47) runs the USE procedure and neither phrase; a START with neither INVALID KEY nor an applicable USE procedure is refused (SR3).

edition-consulted.switches: InForce (Year < 2002): refuses a START with no INVALID KEY and no applicable USE (COBOL6826); 2002+ prints no such rule

reader.edition-search: EmitUseHook / EmitPhrasePair / EmitInvalid read in full: no edition test; their EC branch depends on ec.IoMaskFor and ecState, not on the edition directly.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 1985 a START without INVALID KEY and without an applicable USE procedure is refused (SR3); at 2002+ it compiles. The run-time transfer is the same code.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f20_06 covers both phrases with success and invalid key; the USE path, the 47 path, GO TO out of the phrase and the SR3 refusal are probed here.

probes.printed: T1/T2 (47, both phrases written): USE-R ST=47, neither T1-INV nor T1-NOTINV; T3 (23, only NOT INVALID): USE-R ST=23, no T3-NOTINV; T4 (00, only NOT INVALID): T4-NOTINV, no USE; T5 INVALID KEY GO TO -> T5 JUMPED, T5-FELL-THROUGH not shown; T7: T7-INV only
START with only END-START, and with only NOT INVALID KEY, no USE -> COBOL6826 §1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR3

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR7  (║4.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR7
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 The Invalid Key Condition)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GR3

reader.notes: EmitStart builds the hook with invalidKeyHandled from the bound phrase, so a written INVALID KEY suppresses the declarative for 23 only; EmitPhrasePair runs INVALID KEY on the invalid-key class and NOT INVALID KEY on success. p3ctl.cob prints the same at --std 2023. The 1985-only part is the SR3 screen in ExceptionPhraseRequirement.Require.

refuter.evidence: Read ExceptionPhraseRequirement.Require/HasApplicableUse (1985-only SR3 screen: file-named USE, mode USE, containing program's GLOBAL USE) and VIII.1.3.5. Probes at --std 85: q1ext.cob mode-only declaratives (USE ON EXTEND/INPUT/OUTPUT), no INVALID KEY: compiles; START on file open EXTEND -> USE-EXTEND runs with 47, NOT INVALID not run; open INPUT failing START -> USE-INPUT runs with 23, NOT INVALID not run; success -> E4-NOTINV only. q5glob.cob USE GLOBAL ON a GLOBAL file in the container, START in the contained program without INVALID KEY: compiles, 23 -> USE-R-GLOBAL, 00 -> G2-NOTINV. q6loc.cob same without GLOBAL -> COBOL6826 (SR3). q4c.cob only a USE naming another file plus USE ON EXTEND on a dynamic-access file -> COBOL6826 for both phrase-less STARTs (a dynamic file cannot be opened EXTEND, §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1, so that USE is never applicable). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR7 ... the text is in GR7'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR3 ... the text is in SR3'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.5 ... it lies in GR2'.
